founders-fund._readme: Identity corrections for Founders Fund, re-applied on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8). Each merge is one company filed or listed under two names.

never_merge.reason: Two companies: Compass, the real-estate brokerage the firm seeded as Urban Compass (/company/compass from 2019), and Compass Pathways, the psilocybin company (/company/compass-pathways). The builder's name-prefix rule folded the first into the second on the 2026-10-06 build.

merges.name: Compass
merges.reason: The firm's page moved from /company/urban-compass (2013-14) to /company/compass (2019 on) when Urban Compass renamed itself Compass in 2015; FF Angel IV, LLC is on Compass's investors' rights agreement (S-1, 2021).

merges.name: Gowalla
merges.reason: The 2010-13 site lists the company as 'Alamofire / Gowalla' (Alamofire Inc. was Gowalla's legal name); the Form D issuer is Gowalla Inc.

merges.name: The Athletic
merges.reason: The Athletic Media Company is the legal name of The Athletic (Form D issuer; Napoleon Ta director).

merges.name: The Climate Corporation
merges.reason: Climate Corp is the Form D issuer name of The Climate Corporation (formerly WeatherBill).

merges.name: Wish
merges.reason: ContextLogic Inc. is the legal name of Wish; the funds' 13G and Forms 3/4 are filed on it.

merges.name: SpaceX
merges.reason: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. is SpaceX's legal name.

merges.name: Oscar
merges.reason: Mulberry Health Inc. is the legal name under which Oscar Health filed its Form D and its draft registration statement.

merges.name: Rippling
merges.reason: People Center, Inc. is Rippling's legal name (Form D issuer; Napoleon Ta director).

merges.name: Forward
merges.reason: GoForward, Inc. is the legal name of Forward, the primary-care company (Form D issuer; Keith Rabois director).

merges.name: Workrise
merges.reason: RigUp renamed itself Workrise in January 2021; the firm's page moved with it.

merges.name: Lyft
merges.reason: Zimride renamed itself Lyft in 2013; The Founders Fund IV, LP is party to Lyft's investors' rights agreement.

merges.name: HQ
merges.reason: Intermedia Labs, Inc. is the company behind HQ Trivia (Form D issuer; Cyan Banister director).

merges.name: Long-Term Stock Exchange
merges.reason: LTSE Services, Inc. is an entity of the Long-Term Stock Exchange group; one investment (Brian Singerman director on both issuers).

merges.name: Ghost Autonomy
merges.reason: Ghost Locomotion Inc. renamed itself Ghost Autonomy Inc.; same CIK lineage and director (Keith Rabois).

merges.name: Lookout
merges.reason: Flexilis Inc. renamed itself Lookout in 2010 (Kevin Hartz director on both issuers).

merges.name: Cedar
merges.reason: Careportal, Inc. is Cedar's legal name: five Form D filings from December 2016, Ken Howery director from the first; Cedar is on the firm's live list.

merges.name: Found
merges.reason: Indie Technologies, Inc. is the legal name of Found: its January 2022 and June 2024 filings are Found's Series B (led by Founders Fund) and Series C.

merges.name: OpenStore
merges.reason: Miami Labs, Inc. is OpenStore's legal name (Keith Rabois executive officer; $30M and $75M filings of 2021).

merges.name: All Day Kitchens
merges.reason: EDGAR: All Day Technologies, Inc., formerly Virtual Kitchen Co., one CIK (1778911).

merges.name: Hutch
merges.reason: Homee renamed itself Hutch in 2017 (PYMNTS, 2017-06-19); Stephen Oskoui director on both issuers.

merges.name: Signature Therapeutics
merges.reason: Pharmacofore renamed itself Signature Therapeutics in 2012; the firm's site carried both pages that year.
